## Change

Describe the user or operational outcome and the bounded implementation scope.

## Validation

- [ ] `./scripts/validate-release.sh`
- [ ] Relevant staging scenarios identified

## Release governance

- [ ] Independent security and accessibility review impact assessed
- [ ] Pilot and rollback impact assessed
